statement:
∀ (c d : ℝ),
  c < d →
    sInf ((fun x => if ∃ q, ↑q = x then 1 else 0) '' Icc c d) = 0 ∧
      sSup ((fun x => if ∃ q, ↑q = x then 1 else 0) '' Icc c d) = 1 ∧
        (∫ (x : ℝ) in c..d, if ∃ q, ↑q = x then 1 else 0) = 0
